title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: selfloop
text:
self-loop
self-loop
(definition)
Definition:
An
edge
of a
graph
which starts and ends at the same
vertex
.
Note:
Some types of graphs allow self-loops, and some do not.
